title: MODFLOW6 Tangent Coupling Contract

canonical.head: d0a41c39d7ff95db99bcf8360ac9b474fdf164d7
canonical.relevant_delta_since_8e0de81: No identified F-GC30 runtime, transaction, tangent or groundwater-coupling dependency change. Subsequent canonical moves inspected were documentation/governance refinements outside this dependency surface.

scientific_conclusions: F-GC30 coupling head is hydraulic head at the fixed SWAP lower face, not the diagnosed freatic groundwater level.
For B1.10 prescribed qbot, lower-face pressure head is h_n + d*(1 + qbot/K_n), with d=0.5*dz_n.
Its qbot derivative requires both terminal dh_n/dqbot and dK_n/dqbot and is qualified independently against centered finite difference.
An admitted drainage-free F-KT21 bottom-flux trajectory can now be transformed into an authoritative terminal fixed-face H_bot,end and dH_bot,end/dqbot without mutating state.
Native qbot is positive into SWAP. F-GC30 q_u is positive outward from SWAP, so zero head change gives q_u=-qbot.
The historical coupling coefficient is u=dt/(dH_bot_end/dqbot) in consistent native SWAP length/time units.
accepted_storage_change is not semantically interchangeable with the historical coupling-storage coefficient.
Centered finite difference remains both fallback and independent qualification oracle.
Predictor provenance must not reuse groundwater_interface_lineage_t because its groundwater candidate_revision does not yet exist when the SWAP predictor response is formed.
H_bot,start is the previously committed accepted SWAP interface head. It must not be substituted by accepted_h_groundwater_m when a nonzero converged head residual exists.

predictor_origin.lineage_semantics: accepted SWAP and groundwater origins only; no future groundwater candidate revision
predictor_origin.head_residual_role: retained explicitly; heads are not silently collapsed

derivative_coverage.drainage_reason: dq_dgroundwater_level exists, but the exact production calcgwl state-to-groundwater-level directional seam is not yet qualified/materialized.

qualified_checks: predictor-origin lineage excludes future MODFLOW candidate revision
typed predictor response and historical u/q_u algebra
centered finite-difference fallback and independent oracle
incomplete active drainage analytic tangent fail-closed
accepted F-KT21 qbot trajectory to terminal fixed-face tangent adapter

next_permitted_action: Create the smallest runtime candidate-binding/assembler that proves the accepted predictor origin, kernel candidate lineage/revision, requested coupling window and published F-KT21 trajectory belong to the same immutable SWAP checkpoint. Only after those provenance checks may it compose modflow6_swap_predictor_response_t from H_bot,start, qbot predictor, H_bot,end and dH_bot,end/dqbot.
blocked_actions: Do not infer candidate lineage from worker/generation alone.
Do not use accepted_h_groundwater_m as H_bot,start when accepted SWAP and groundwater heads differ within tolerance.
Do not mark active drainage as analytically covered until exact production groundwater-level postprocessing and d(gwl)/d(qbot) semantics are qualified.
